import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_LIMIT = 30;
    static final long MOD_VALUE = 1000000007L;
    static long totalSum;
    static int mValue;
    static int[][][] fMatrix = new int[65][35][35];
    static int[] sDigits = new int[65];
    static int digitCount = 0;
    static int[][] tempG = new int[35][35];
    static int[] ansA = new int[35];
    static int[] ansB = new int[35];

    static int modDiff(int x, int y) {
        if (x < mValue) {
            return (x - y + mValue) % mValue;
        } else {
            return (x - y + mValue) % mValue;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        totalSum = sc.nextLong();
        mValue = sc.nextInt();

        long t = totalSum;
        while (t != 0) {
            sDigits[++digitCount] = (int)(t % mValue);
            t /= mValue;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= mValue; ++i) {
            fMatrix[1][i][i] = 1;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= mValue; ++i) {
            fMatrix[1][0][i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 2; i <= digitCount; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= mValue; ++j) {
                fMatrix[i][j][j] = 1;
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < mValue; ++j) {
                for (int a = 0; a <= mValue; ++a) {
                    for (int b = 0; b <= mValue; ++b) {
                        for (int c = 0; c <= mValue; ++c) {
                            tempG[a][c] = (int)((tempG[a][c] + (long)fMatrix[i - 1][modDiff(a, j)][modDiff(b, j)] * fMatrix[i][b][c]) % MOD_VALUE);
                        }
                    }
                }
                for (int a = 0; a <= mValue; ++a) {
                    for (int b = 0; b <= mValue; ++b) {
                        fMatrix[i][a][b] = tempG[a][b];
                        tempG[a][b] = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= mValue; ++i) {
            ansA[i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= digitCount; ++i) {
            int sumS = 0;
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= digitCount; ++j) {
                sumS = (sumS + sDigits[j]) % mValue;
            }
            while (sDigits[i] > 0) {
                int decVal = (sumS + sDigits[i]) % mValue;
                for (int a = 0; a <= mValue; ++a) {
                    for (int b = 0; b <= mValue; ++b) {
                        ansB[b] = (int)((ansB[b] + (long)ansA[a] * fMatrix[i][modDiff(a, decVal)][modDiff(b, decVal)]) % MOD_VALUE);
                    }
                }
                for (int a = 0; a <= mValue; ++a) {
                    ansA[a] = ansB[a];
                    ansB[a] = 0;
                }
                sDigits[i]--;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ansA[mValue]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
